contributions.statement: Normalize agent traces from all hosts into a shared action vocabulary (read/search/edit/test/submit) and flag runs with five or more consecutive edits without a test or search step as an early failure signal.
contributions.evidence: §5 Table 8: Moatless+DeepSeek-V3 fail rate 80% with a 5+ edit streak vs 59% without; Claude-3.5 pass 26% to 11%. Two agents, no significance test, older Python SWE-bench trajectories.

reason: The fingerprinting result does not lead to any action for the team, and the ProcGrep-vs-LLM comparison is circular; only the edit-streak signal is a usable, unvalidated hypothesis.
